_comment: Homepage bestsellers. This file is the integration contract between the shop and the homepage: replace the entries below with real products from the catalogue and re-run `node scripts/build.mjs`.
_rules: Never invent price, availability, rating or stock. Leave a field null and the card simply omits that line.
`placeholder: true` renders a visible PLACEHOLDER badge so no unfinished card can ship unnoticed. Set it to false only for real catalogue data.
`badge` is for real, verifiable labels only (e.g. an actual bestseller ranking). Leave null otherwise.
`availability` must mirror real stock data from the commerce backend, or stay null.
Ratings are intentionally absent from this schema: no fake social proof.
